feedStale: No data from the vision-nav agent for {s} s. The values below are the last received.

tour.modeBody: The modes the agent can run, with the current one marked. The plugin's per-drone settings choose the mode; the Engage skill starts and stops it.
tour.sensorsBody: Camera, IMU, and rangefinder health at a glance. The camera row shows whether the agent loaded a camera calibration (camchain.yaml in the plugin's data directory).
tour.estimatorBody: Live state of the active estimator. The pill shows initializing, converging, converged, degraded or failed.
tour.chartsBody: Sixty seconds of rolling history. Watch the flow quality stay above the pre-arm minimum and the camera-IMU sync offset stay green.
tour.preArmBody: Advisory arm-readiness for this mode. It does not stop the flight controller from arming; check every row is green before you arm.

modeCard.title: Mode
modeCard.subhead: The estimator the plugin feeds to the flight controller. The plugin's per-drone settings choose the mode; the Engage skill starts and stops it.
modeCard.awaitingAgent: The agent has not advertised its available estimators yet. Reconnect or wait for the next heartbeat.
modeCard.disengaged: Disengaged: use the Engage skill (Shift+N) to start vision navigation. Off is the effective mode while disengaged.

off.label: Off
off.description: Sensors only. The estimator sends no MAVLink and the EKF is untouched. Useful for hardware diagnostics and calibration runs.

optical_flow.label: Optical Flow
optical_flow.description: Downward camera plus a rangefinder. A Lucas-Kanade tracker feeds the EKF (OPTICAL_FLOW on ArduPilot and iNav, OPTICAL_FLOW_RAD on PX4). The default GPS-denied path.
optical_flow.needs: Downward USB or CSI camera and a rangefinder.

optical_flow_degraded.label: Optical Flow (degraded)
optical_flow_degraded.description: Same tracker as Optical Flow, but the scale comes from the baro / GPS (outdoor) ladder instead of a rangefinder. Reduced accuracy; the estimator state shows degraded.

external_nav.label: External Navigation
external_nav.description: The pose another plugin publishes (for example a planar lidar SLAM) goes to the flight controller as ODOMETRY, and the EKF source set switches to it while it tracks. ArduPilot.
external_nav.needs: A plugin publishing the shared pose topic, and an EKF origin.

sensorsCard.title: Sensors
sensorsCard.calibrationHint: The agent reads a Kalibr camchain.yaml (cam0 block) from the plugin's data directory at start-up.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.mavlinkDenied: Cannot read {msg} from the flight controller: the subscription was refused.
diagnostics.eventDenied: Cannot read the {topic} topic: the subscription was refused.

fallback.reasonStaticScale: No live altitude source; the flow scale is a fixed 1.5 m estimate.
fallback.reasonLowQuality: Optical-flow quality dropped below the pre-arm minimum (50/255).
fallback.reasonSyncDrift: Camera-IMU time sync drifted beyond 30 ms.
fallback.reasonNoScale: No altitude or depth source is healthy to scale the optical flow.
fallback.reasonGeneric: Estimator inputs are below the safe operating envelope.
fallback.suggestionLand: Land, or switch the flight controller back to GPS with your RC source-set switch.
fallback.suggestionRecalibrate: Re-run the camera-IMU calibration before the next flight.
fallback.suggestionSlowYaw: Slow yaw rate and fly over a more textured surface.
fallback.suggestionWatch: Watch closely and prepare to hand back to manual.

preArm.title: Pre-arm
preArm.denied: Mission Control did not grant navigation telemetry.
preArm.subscribeFailed: Could not subscribe to navigation telemetry.

legacy.companionDown: Vision companion is not running. Check agent logs.
legacy.flowLow: Flow quality is below the pre-arm minimum (50/255).
legacy.ekfSource: Configure the EKF source set in the parameter editor.

navState.title: Navigation feed
navState.waiting: Waiting for the agent's navigation state.

ardupilot.title: ArduPilot vision parameters
ardupilot.note: Read-only summary. Edit in Mission Control's parameter editor.

rows.RNGFND1_TYPE: Downward rangefinder backend (10 = MAVLink); flow is scaled by the height above the ground.
rows.EK3_SRC1_POSXY: Source set 1 horizontal position (6 = external nav).
rows.EK3_SRC1_VELXY: Source set 1 horizontal velocity (5 = optical flow with external nav; never 6: the pose's velocity is not trusted).
rows.EK3_SRC1_YAW: Source set 1 yaw (1 = compass; 6 = external nav, only with a declared map north).
rows.EK3_SRC2_VELXY: Source set 2 horizontal velocity (5 = optical flow for the fallback set).
rows.FLOW_HEIGHT_MIN: Minimum height above ground for flow fusion (m).
rows.FLOW_HEIGHT_MAX: Maximum height above ground for flow fusion (m).
rows.VISO_DELAY_MS: How old a pose is when its ODOMETRY reaches the flight controller (ms).
rows.AHRS_OPTIONS: 16: set the EKF origin at boot from AHRS_ORIGIN_LAT/LON/ALT (GNSS-denied, ArduPilot 4.7+).
rows.AHRS_ORIGIN_LAT: Take-off site latitude for the boot-time EKF origin.
rows.AHRS_ORIGIN_LON: Take-off site longitude for the boot-time EKF origin.
rows.AHRS_ORIGIN_ALT: Take-off site altitude for the boot-time EKF origin.
rows.COMPASS_AUTODEC: Before ArduPilot 4.7: 0, with COMPASS_DEC set to the site's declination.
rows.EK3_MAG_EF_LIM: With COMPASS_AUTODEC on: above 0 (default 50), so a late declination step cannot reach the yaw.
rows.ARMING_SKIPCHK: GNSS-denied: 8 skips the GPS pre-arm check.

px4.title: PX4 vision parameters
px4.note: Read-only summary. Edit in Mission Control's parameter editor and restart the EKF after changes.

rows.EKF2_OF_CTRL: Optical flow fusion control (PX4 1.14 and newer).
rows.SENS_FLOW_MAXR: Maximum flow rate the sensor reports (rad/s).

inav.title: iNav optical-flow parameters
inav.note: Read-only summary. Edit in Mission Control's parameter editor over MSP.

rows.opflow_hardware: Optical flow driver. Set to MAVLINK to consume the plugin's OPTICAL_FLOW messages over the FC's MAVLink rx UART.
rows.opflow_scale: Pixels-per-radian scale. Leave the default with the MAVLINK driver; the plugin sends pre-scaled angular rates.
rows.nav_use_optflow_for_poshold: Set to ON. Enables position hold (NAV POSHOLD mode) using the optical-flow stream when GPS is unavailable.
rows.nav_extra_arming_safety: When ON the FC refuses to arm until flow quality is reported as healthy. Recommended for indoor and over-ground flight.
rows.nav_landing_speed: Vertical speed during NAV LAND. Tune so landings stay inside the rangefinder's valid altitude band.
rows.rangefinder_hardware: Set to the wired driver (LIDARMT for MTF-01, VL53L1X, TFMINI, etc.) or MSP to relay a companion-side reading.
rows.nav_rangefinder_for_terrain: Set to ON for terrain following on top of flow-based position hold.

notes.version: iNav 7.0 or newer is required for OPTICAL_FLOW reception over MAVLink rx.
notes.serial: Set the FC's serial port function to MAVLINK on the UART wired to the ADOS Drone Agent.
notes.component: The plugin's component id is 198. iNav accepts the message from any component when opflow_hardware = MAVLINK.

lines.estimator: Betaflight is a racing and freestyle flight stack. It does not ship a position estimator.
lines.ekf: Optical flow needs a consumer inside the FC's EKF to fuse flow samples into. Betaflight has neither an EKF nor a position controller.
lines.upstream: This is a deliberate firmware-upstream choice. The plugin cannot work around it from the companion side.
lines.crossFlash: Operators on Betaflight hardware who need GPS-denied flight should cross-flash iNav or ArduPilot Copter on the same FC. Most STM32F405, F722, and H743 boards run all three firmwares.
